source: When Lord Mengchang heard that Feng Chen had burned the deed, he was very angry and immediately sent someone to recall Feng Chen. As soon as Feng Chen arrived, Lord Mengchang asked: "I have three thousand diners, so I lend money in Xue Yi." My fiefdom is small to begin with, but the people still do not repay the interest on time, and the guests are afraid that they will not have enough to eat, so I asked you, sir, to collect the debts. I heard that after receiving the money, my husband held a banquet of wine and meat and burned the deed. Why is this? Feng Xuan replied: Yes. If there is no way to gather all the debtors together without throwing a feast of wine and meat, there will be no way to know who is rich and who is poor. If he is wealthy, he will be given a set date to repay his debts. The poor will not be able to repay their debts even if they are detained for ten years. The longer the time, the higher the interest. If you are too hasty, they will not be able to repay you in the end. On the one hand, you will be thought to be greedy for small profits and not caring for the people. On the other hand, the people will have a reputation of abandoning the emperor and relying on debts. This is not a way to encourage scholars and people and show your reputation. I burned the useless IOUs and discarded the nominal account books to make the common people of Xue Yi trust you and promote your good reputation for kindness. What else do you have to doubt? After hearing this, Lord Mengchang clapped his hands and thanked him repeatedly. The King of Qi was bewitched by the slanderous remarks of Qin and Chu, and believed that Lord Mengchang's reputation was higher than his own and that he would monopolize the power of Qi, so he dismissed Lord Mengchang from his official position. When the guests saw that Lord Mengchang had been dismissed, they all left him. Only Feng Xuan planned for him and said: Lend me a car and let me go to Qin. I will definitely make you more prominent in Qi and your city will be wider. Do you think it's okay? So Mengchangjun prepared a carriage and gifts to send Feng Xuan on the road. Feng Chen then drove west to the state of Qin to lobby the king of Qin, saying: All lobbyists in the world who drive west to the state of Qin all want to make Qin strong and make Qi weak; everyone who rides east to enter the state of Qi all want to make Qi strong and make Qin weak. These are two countries with no distinction between superior and inferior. It is impossible for them to stand side by side and dominate. The one who dominates can unify the world. The King of Qin was fascinated by what he heard. He straightened up and knelt down and asked Feng Xuan: "What do you think should be done to prevent Qin from becoming a weak country?" Feng Chen replied: Your Majesty also knows that the State of Qi has dismissed Lord Mengchang from his position, right? King Qin said: I heard about this. Feng Xuan said: The person who made Qi respected by the world was Lord Mengchang. Now that the king of Qi has listened to the slander and dismissed Lord Mengchang, Lord Mengchang is extremely resentful and will definitely betray Qi. If he betrays Qi and enters Qin, then the national conditions of Qi and the situation in the court, from the king to the officials, will be under the control of Qin. You will get the entire land of Qi, and you will be more than just the hero! Hurry up and send an envoy with gifts to meet Lord Mengchang secretly. Don't miss this opportunity. If King Qi comes to his senses and appoints Lord Mengchang again, then it is impossible to predict who will win or lose. The King of Qin was very happy after hearing this, and sent ten carriages carrying a hundred yi gold to meet Lord Mengchang. Feng Xuan said goodbye to the King of Qin and rushed to the State of Qi ahead of the envoy. When he arrived at the State of Qi, he persuaded the King of Qi: The lobbyists from all over the world who drive east to Qi State all want to make Qi strong and make Qin weak; those who ride west to Qin State all want to make Qin strong and make Qi weak. Qin and Qi are equally superior and inferior. If Qin is strong, Qi must be weak. These two countries will inevitably not be able to dominate at the same time. Now I heard privately that the Qin State has sent an envoy with ten carriages carrying a hundred yi gold to greet Lord Mengchang. It's fine if Lord Mengchang doesn't go west. If he goes west and serves as the prime minister of Qin, then the world will belong to Qin. If Qin becomes the lord, Qi will have no choice but to succumb to it. Then Linzi and Jimo will be in danger. Why didn't the king quickly restore Mengchang to his official position and increase his fiefdom to apologize to him before the Qin envoy arrived? If this is done, Lord Mengchang will be happy and willing to accept it. Although Qin is a powerful country, how can it arbitrarily go to other countries to welcome other people's prime ministers? It is necessary to thwart Qin's conspiracy and cut off its plan to seek strength and hegemony. After hearing this, King Qi immediately understood and said: OK. So he sent people to the border to wait for the Qin envoy. As soon as the Qin envoy's car entered the Qi border, the Qi envoy at the border immediately changed his car and drove back to report the situation. The King of Qi recalled Mengchang Jun and restored his position as prime minister. At the same time, he also gave him the land of the original fiefdom and added a thousand households to him. When the envoy from Qin heard that Lord Mengchang had restored his position as prime minister of Qi, he changed his carriage and went back. Since the King of Qi dismissed Lord Mengchang because of the slander, all the guests have left him. Later, the King of Qi recalled and restored Lord Mengchang to his official position, and Feng Chen went to greet him.
gold_target: Feng Chen, a poor scholar, joined Lord Mengchang's household. Initially placed in low-class quarters, he sang about lacking fish, a carriage, and means to support his family, prompting Lord Mengchang to upgrade his status. When Lord Mengchang needed to collect debts in Xue Yi, Feng Chen was sent. Instead of collecting, he burned the deeds of the poor, arguing that this would earn the people's trust and enhance Lord Mengchang's reputation. Though initially angry, Lord Mengchang later thanked him. When Lord Mengchang was dismissed as prime minister, his guests abandoned him. Feng Chen went to Qin, convincing King Zhao to send gifts to recruit Lord Mengchang. He then urged King Qi to restore Lord Mengchang's position before the Qin envoy arrived, which King Qi did. When Lord Mengchang expressed bitterness toward his former guests, Feng Chen explained that people naturally flock to the wealthy and abandon the poor, advising him to forgive them. Lord Mengchang accepted this counsel.

source: Before arriving in the capital, Mengchang Jun sighed deeply and said: I always like to make friends with guests and take care of people. I never dare to be rude when receiving guests. It's not that people like morning and hate evening, but because what they expected is no longer available in the East and West markets. Whenever he goes to court and has the opportunity to give advice to the emperor, he will be praised by the most respected people in the world. He recommended scholars and his subordinates, prime ministers and officials, and talked about them with great interest. He often praised them as more capable than himself. Although Zheng Zhuang was popular with outsiders, he often agreed to obey his master's wishes in court and did not dare to express his views on right and wrong too clearly. In his later years, the Han Dynasty conquered the Xiongnu and recruited ethnic minorities in various places. The world spent a lot of money and the country's financial and material resources were even more scarce. The people recommended by Zheng Zhuang and their guests were responsible for transportation for the great peasant order, and they owed a lot of money. When he became a county magistrate, there was no property left in his family after his death. Tai Shigong said: Because Ji An and Zheng were so virtuous at that time, when they were powerful, the number of guests would be ten times greater, but when they were powerless, the situation was completely the opposite. Zhai Gong of Xiajun County once said that when he first served as a court official, his house was full of guests; but when he lost his official position, the outside became so deserted that people could gather to catch birds.

source: Confucius said: The Six Classics have the same role in governing the country. "Li" is used to regulate people's words and deeds, "Music" is used to promote people's harmony, "Book" is used to record past deeds and regulations, "Poetry" is used to express emotions, "Yi" is used to spy on the magical changes of heaven and earth, and "Spring and Autumn" is used to understand the meaning of subtle words and weigh the right and wrong. Tai Shigong said: The truth in the world is vast and boundless, isn't it great! If the words can be slightly to the point, it can also resolve a lot of troubles. Chunyu Kun was a son-in-law of Qi State. Less than seven feet tall, he is funny and eloquent. He has been on many missions to the princes and has never been humiliated. When King Wei of Qi was in power, he liked to talk in argot, feast all night long, indulge in excessive drinking, ignored state affairs, and entrusted political affairs to the officials. The civil and military officials are dissolute and indulgent, and the princes and countries invade and invade. The country is in danger and is in danger in a matter of seconds. None of the ministers around King Qi dared to give advice. Chunyu Kun used argot to admonish and admonish King Wei of Qi, saying: There is a big bird in the capital that landed in the king's courtyard. It has not flown or screamed for three years. Does the king know what happened to this bird? King Wei of Qi said: If this bird does not fly, it will go straight to the sky; if it does not scream, it will amaze people. So he ordered all the chiefs of the seventy-two counties in the country to come to the court to report. They rewarded one person and killed another. They also sent troops to defend against the enemy. The princes and states were shocked and returned the occupied land to Qi. Qi's prestige lasted for thirty-six years. All these things are recorded in "Tian Wan Family". In the eighth year of King Wei of Qi's reign, the State of Chu sent a large army to invade its borders. The King of Qi sent Chunyu Kun as an envoy to the State of Zhao to request reinforcements, and asked him to carry a gift of a hundred catties of gold and ten four-horse carriages. Chunyu Kun looked up to the sky and laughed so hard that the string holding his hat broke. King Wei said: Sir, do you think the gift is too little? Chunyu Kun said: How dare you think too little! King Wei said: Then you laugh, do you have any excuse? Chunyu Kun said: Today I came from the east and saw a man worshiping the God of the Fields by the roadside. He held a pig's trotter and a glass of wine and prayed: "The grain harvested in the highlands fills the bonnet, and the crops harvested in the low fields fill the vehicles; the grains are lush and ripe, and the rice grains are piled up in the warehouse." I saw that he brought few sacrifices and prayed for many things, so I laughed at him. So King Wei of Qi increased the gifts to a thousand pieces of gold, ten pairs of white jade stones, and a hundred four-horse carriages. Chunyu Kun said goodbye and set off for the Kingdom of Zhao. King Zhao allocated him 100,000 elite soldiers and 1,000 leather-wrapped chariots. When the Chu State heard the news, they withdrew their troops overnight. King Qi Wei was very happy. He set up wine and food in the harem, summoned Chunyu Kun and gave him wine to drink. Ask him: How much wine can you drink before you get drunk?
gold_target: Confucius stated that the Six Classics serve the same purpose in governing a country: "Li" regulates conduct, "Music" promotes harmony, "Book" records past deeds, "Poetry" expresses emotions, "Yi" explores cosmic changes, and "Spring and Autumn" discerns subtle meanings and right from wrong. Tai Shigong remarked on the vastness of truth, noting that concise words can resolve many troubles. Chunyu Kun, a short, witty son-in-law of Qi, often served as an envoy without disgrace. During King Wei of Qi's reign, the king neglected state affairs, indulging in feasting and drinking, leading to invasions and national peril. No minister dared to advise. Chunyu Kun used an allegory of a great bird that neither flew nor cried for three years. King Wei understood, summoned all county chiefs, rewarded one, executed another, and repelled invaders, restoring Qi's prestige for 36 years. Later, when Chu invaded, Chunyu Kun was sent to Zhao for reinforcements with modest gifts. He laughed at a farmer praying for abundant harvests with meager offerings, prompting King Wei to increase the gifts. Zhao then sent 100,000 elite troops, causing Chu to withdraw. King Wei asked Chunyu Kun about his drinking capacity. Chunyu Kun explained that his drunkenness varied by context: fear made him drunk after one measure, while joy allowed him to drink eight measures. He warned against excess, as it leads to decline. King Wei ceased nightly drinking and appointed Chunyu Kun as a guest official.

source: King Zhuang asked: What should we do? You Meng replied: I requested that the coffin be made of beautiful jade with carved patterns, the cover of fine catalpa wood, and the coffin blocks made of valuable woods such as urin, maple, hemp, and camphor. I sent soldiers to dig a grave for it, and asked the elderly and children to carry earth to build the tomb. When the princes heard this, they all knew that the king despised people and valued horses. King Zhuang said: "Has my fault reached this level?" What to do about it? Umeng said: Please allow me to bury it in the same way as an animal: pile an earth stove on the ground as a set, use a large copper pot as a coffin, use ginger and dates to season, use spices to relieve the smell, use rice as a sacrifice, use fire as clothes, and bury it in the human belly. So King Zhuang sent someone to give the horse to the eunuch in charge of the palace's meals, so that the people in the world would not spread the matter for a long time. Sun Shuao, the prime minister of Chu, knew that Youmeng was a wise man and treated him well. When Sun Shuao was seriously ill and about to die, he told his son: After I die, you will definitely be poor. At that time, you go to see Youmeng and say that I am Sun Shuao's son. A few years later, Sun Shuao's son was indeed so poor that he had to rely on firewood to survive. Once I met Youmeng on the road, he said to Youmeng: I am Sun Shuao's son. Before my father died, he asked me to go see Youmeng when I was in poverty. Youmeng said: Don't go far away. So, he immediately sewed clothes and hats similar to Sun Shuao's and wore them, imitating Sun Shuao's speech, behavior, voice and smile. After more than a year, he imitated Sun Shuao so much that even the officials around King Zhuang of Chu could not tell him apart. King Zhuang of Chu held a banquet, and Youmeng came forward to toast and bless King Zhuang. King Zhuang was shocked, thinking that Sun Shuao had come back to life again, and wanted to make him Prime Minister of Chu. Youmeng said: "Please allow me to go back and discuss this matter with my wife, and come back in three days to take up the post of Prime Minister of Chu." King Zhuang agreed to him. Three days later, Youmeng came to see King Zhuang again. King Zhuang asked: What did your wife say? Youmeng said: My wife told me not to do it. It is not worthy to be the prime minister of Chu State. Like Sun Shuao, who was the prime minister of the Chu State and governed the Chu State with loyalty and integrity, the king of Chu was able to dominate. Now that he is dead, his son has no place to stand and is so poor that he has to carry firewood to make a living every day. If you want to be the prime minister of Chu like Sun Shuao, you might as well commit suicide. Umeng then sang: Living in the mountains and fields, it is difficult to live in the fields and suffer hardships. Those who go out to serve as officials, are themselves corrupt and despicable, accumulate excess wealth, and have no regard for their integrity. After his death, although his family was wealthy, he was afraid of corruption, bending the law, doing illegal things, and committing serious crimes. He was killed and his family was also destroyed. What can a corrupt official do? I want to be an upright official, abide by the law, be loyal to my duties, and never dare to do anything illegal until my death. Alas, what can an upright official do? For example, Sun Shuao, Prime Minister of Chu, insisted on integrity throughout his life, but now his wife, children and children are so poor that they have to collect firewood for a living. It’s really not worth being an upright official! So King Zhuang expressed his apology to You Meng, and immediately summoned Sun Shuao's son and granted him the city of Qiuqiu with 400 households for the purpose of worshiping Sun Shuao.
gold_target: Over a century later, You Meng, a tall Chu performer, used humor to advise King Zhuang. When the king wanted to bury his beloved horse with grand rites, You Meng suggested an even grander burial to expose the king's folly. King Zhuang relented and had the horse cooked. Later, You Meng impersonated the deceased prime minister Sun Shuao to advise King Zhuang. He highlighted Sun Shuao's poverty despite his integrity, leading the king to grant Sun's son land and households for ancestral worship.
